sections.description:
Cool Payment Gateway Getnet for WooCommerce

Official plugin documentation

docs

External services

This plugin uses the Getnet API service to process payments.
Getnet is a payment gateway provider that allows you to process payments in Argentina.
This plugin sends the customer checkout data from WooCommerce to Getnet API to process the payment in order to get the payment link.
Getnet Site Url: https://www.getnet.com.ar
Getnet Terms of Service: https://www.getnet.com.ar/tyc
Getnet Privacy Policy: https://www.getnet.com.ar/privacidad
Getnet Documentation: https://www.getnet.com.ar/cobra-online/get-checkout
Getnet Dashboard: https://dashboard.globalgetnet.com.ar
Getnet API Services: https://api.globalgetnet.com.ar, https://auth.geopagos.com/oauth/token
